product_purpose: Apply at most one daily boost to the current mapped Food Farm, preferring one exact matching owned item; only when no matching item is owned may the exact current one-day Food Farm Diamond option be used at or below the 48-Diamond authorization cap after fresh price/balance checks and confirmation recheck.

postconditions: Only the current safely bound mapped Food Farm is entered.
The initial Farm tap may collect output from multiple buildings; record before-and-after balances and each resource delta before any boost decision.
Reconcile exact current balances and deltas for Food, Wood, Steel, and Gas, including all buildings collected by the initial tap.
Collection is not boost completion; unknown or partial balance effects block further input.
Observe exact matching owned Food Farm boost item identity, quantity, and duration independently.
An action cost of one item is not evidence of total inventory count.
This branch is allowed only when the exact matching owned item is independently observed with positive quantity and matching duration.
Use exactly one item; item-first preference forbids Diamonds when an eligible owned item exists.
This branch is allowed only when the exact matching owned item count is independently observed as zero.

Observe the exact current one-day Food Farm option, fresh numeric Diamond price, and current Diamond balance; price must be no more than the 48-Diamond authorization cap and balance must cover the exact observed price.
The cap is not the current price; unknown, changed, or mismatched offer blocks.
Recheck exact current offer, numeric price, and balance immediately before any confirmation; a changed confirmation blocks.
Buy exactly one matching one-day Food Farm option at or below the 48-Diamond authorization cap, never infer current price from the cap.
Same mapped Food Farm identity positively shows Boosting with a positive current timer.
A purchase/item dispatch or collection output alone is not success proof; reconcile attempt and confirmed counts under the reset identity.
The route-owned source-bound return reaches current canonical Home.

cost_quantity_requirements.notes: Owned matching item is first choice; action cost 1 is not inventory count. The 48-Diamond authorization cap is not the current price; Diamond fallback requires exact observed current price ≤48 when matching owned count is zero, current balance covering that exact price, and confirmation recheck.

cooldown_deferred_behavior: Defer when one boost was already attempted or confirmed this reset, matching inventory/offer is unavailable, or the exact current Diamond balance is insufficient; retain separately reconciled collection and boost effects.
bounded_recovery_behavior: Stop before boosting on unknown mapped Farm, partial multi-building collection accounting, inventory count, item identity/duration, exact current offer/price/balance, changed confirmation, timer successor, reset identity, or Home. Never use Buy Box, Resource Building Boost, global Food Output Boost, real-money confirmation, second boost, or identical retry.
evidence_requirements: Current source-bound native evidence for mapped Farm identity; initial Farm tap and exact per-resource pre/post balances/deltas across all collected buildings; matching item inventory identity/count/duration; item-first branch; exact current one-day Diamond offer, fresh numeric price ≤48 authorization cap, current balance and confirmation recheck only when item count is zero; same-Farm Boosting positive timer; attempt-versus-confirmed persistence; reset identity; and canonical Home.
No native acceptance, capture identifier, or live readiness is asserted.

replay_fixture_requirements.notes: No synthetic fixture substitutes for current Farm collection, item inventory, exact price/balance, and active timer evidence.

unsupported_or_manual_only_states: unknown or partially reconciled multi-building collection
item action cost mistaken for inventory count

required_evidence: The complete native evidence set listed in evidence_requirements, including exact collection and boost effect reconciliation.

scenarios.notes: This is a disabled, evidence-gated contract. Product authority lists the only route-owned action classes; this scenario authorizes no runtime input until the native gate is satisfied.
